renderings.value: He makes believe that he is a practical statesman, but in really he is a cunning politician.
He posed as my close friend.
The talented young chess player is very bold. He deliberately lays himself open to attack, makes himself vulnerable and then checkmates his opponent when least expected.
The unique cakes here are only unique to make it look like a good deal.
Posing on a fake account is a clever trick to put your parents' minds at ease.
It was revealed that the government had manipulated statistical data to create the appearance of economic growth.
